explicitly_not: NOT a completed gold standard. The 15-unit gate is NOT applied and NOT forced; the exercise is reported at the size it actually reached.
part2_deductive_status: NOT_CONDUCTED — prior human anchor available; current coder exercise limited to partial emergent review
interpretive_metrics: WITHHELD — the metrics that required a completed gold standard remain withheld
agreement_note: NOT computed and NOT computable yet. Agreement may only be calculated after a human completes the clustering/adjudication, and then only over U01-U07.
no_data_invented: Units neither coder completed are reported as empty. Nothing is imputed for them.

blind_pooling.randomisation: per-unit deterministic shuffle seeded by sha256('partial_emergent::'+unit_id) — reproducible for audit, carries no authorship signal

scope_confirmed_by_researcher.statement: both coders reviewed exactly the same first seven units, U01-U07
scope_confirmed_by_researcher.treated_as: 7 shared units, 2 independent coders, doubly-coded common subset

structural_finding_u04.what_the_files_show: Coder B's U04 rows carry theme_label, theme_description and supporting_quote but leave `relevance` blank on both themes. By the completeness rule used here (all four fields) they are PARTIAL, not complete.
structural_finding_u04.decision: U04 is retained in the shared set of seven and pooled for clustering, because the substantive content is present. The two rows are marked relevance='(not provided)' in the workbook rather than imputed.
structural_finding_u04.why_not_dropped: Dropping U04 would shrink the shared set to six and discard real coded content over one missing field.
structural_finding_u04.why_not_imputed: No relevance value is invented for those two themes.

coder_a_extra_unit.status: OUT_OF_SCOPE — coded by Coder A only
coder_a_extra_unit.treatment: excluded from clustering and from any future agreement computation; one coder alone carries no agreement information

units_not_reviewed.explicitly_not: NOT thematic absences and NOT zeros. Nothing is filled in for them and they must not enter any denominator.

quote_validation.note: every supporting quote is verbatim in its issued unit text

downstream_pending_human_adjudication: shared vs exclusive theme counts after clustering
cluster presence matrix by unit and coder
preliminary saturation assessment (no claim of complete saturation)
exploratory comparison against the sealed codebook — LAST, after clustering

record_of_scope.statement: Both coders substantively reviewed U01-U07. The seven units are the doubly-coded common subset.

coder_b_incomplete_field.consequence_for_clustering: U04 ENTERS thematic clustering — the substantive content is present.
coder_b_incomplete_field.consequence_for_centrality: The two centrality values for Coder B's U04 themes remain MISSING until Coder B supplies them. They are NOT imputed as central or secondary, and NOT treated as peripheral by default.
coder_b_incomplete_field.how_it_appears_in_the_workbook: relevance reads '(not provided)' on pooled rows P034 and P040

coder_a_out_of_scope_unit.reason: coded by one coder only; a single coder's unit carries no agreement information and is excluded from clustering and from any future agreement computation

not_reviewed.explicitly_not: not thematic absences, not zeros, not denominators. Nothing is filled in for them.

deferred_until_human_clustering_complete.agreement: NOT COMPUTED — free-text labels cannot be compared before clustering
deferred_until_human_clustering_complete.saturation: NOT ASSESSED — requires the cumulative cluster curve
deferred_until_human_clustering_complete.codebook_comparison: NOT PERFORMED — must follow emergent clustering, not precede it
